properties.name: id
properties.description: Task condition - must be used in combination with a partition.

properties.name: limit
properties.description: Maximum number of tasks to lock and execute.

properties.name: processInstanceId
properties.description: Process instance condition - must be used in combination with a partition.

properties.name: type
properties.description:
TaskType describes the different types of tasks, an engine needs to execute.

Management related types (e.g. creating a partition or purging expired messages) are only relevant for a pg engine.
